name: People's Republic of Kampuchea
native: សាធារណរដ្ឋប្រជាមានិតកម្ពុជា (Sathéarônârôdth Brâchéaméanĭt Kâmpŭchéa)

predecessors.name: Democratic Kampuchea (Khmer Rouge)
predecessors.text: Democratic Kampuchea, overthrown by the Vietnamese army and the KUFNS in early 1979

successors.name: Kingdom of Cambodia
successors.text: the whole of Cambodia under the restored monarchy

ledger.x: 1979: the People's Republic of Kampuchea is proclaimed at Phnom Penh.
1979: the Khmer Rouge hold out on the Thai frontier.
1989: the PRK becomes the State of Cambodia.
24 October 1989: the Khmer Rouge take Pailin after the Vietnamese withdrawal.
October 1991: the Paris Peace Agreements (23 October) open reconciliation and UNTAC (established 28 February 1992) supervises the ceasefire.
September 1993: the state ends with the restoration of the monarchy.

wars.name: Cambodian-Vietnamese War
wars.outcome: The Vietnamese army and the KUFNS overthrow Democratic Kampuchea in January 1979 and set up the PRK; the Khmer Rouge, the KPNLF and FUNCINPEC (the CGDK of 1982) fight from the Thai border until the Vietnamese withdrawal (21-26 September 1989) and the 1991…

certainty.note: Control inside the frontier is approximate: the army held 'the major population centres' and the resistance the Thai-border camps and outposts, with no extent given by either page.
The 1991 Paris accords and UNTAC's ceasefire supervision; the page gives no frontier change.
